department: Department of Public Health Sciences (Ph.D. in Biostatistics)

app_fee.value: Public Health applies through SOPHAS, not the Graduate School portal, so the $85 university fee does not apply; the page gives no amount.
app_fee.quote: These programs apply through their own portals

fee_waiver.value: Public Health offers no application fee waivers; applicants must ask SOPHAS.
fee_waiver.quote: The Department of Public Health Sciences does not provide application fee waivers

deadline.value: The page lists Fall 2026 dates only (final deadline January 1, 2026); Fall 2027 dates were not posted.

gre_general.value: Biostatistics applicants must submit GRE General scores from the last five years, with no waivers.
gre_general.quote: Ph.D. in Biostatistics and Ph.D. in Epidemiology applicants are required to submit GRE general exam scores taken within the last five years - no substitutions or waivers are granted

toefl_min.value: Public Health requires a TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo score but gives no minimum; the school sets its own rule.
toefl_min.quote: International applicants whose native language is not English are required to submit TOEFL, IELTS, or DET (Duolingo English Test) scores

ielts_min.value: Public Health requires an IELTS score but gives no minimum; the school sets its own rule.
ielts_min.quote: International applicants whose native language is not English are required to submit TOEFL, IELTS, or DET (Duolingo English Test) scores

english_waiver.value: The Public Health application pages do not describe an English-medium degree waiver; the school sets its own rule.

supervisor.value: The application page does not say whether a faculty supervisor is needed before admission.

funding.value: Departmental scholarships go to eligible candidates; the page does not say all admitted students are funded.
funding.quote: We offer scholarships to eligible candidates

entry_route.value: The pages do not say whether a master's is needed for the PhD.

gre_subject.value: The Biostatistics PhD requires GRE General scores; the page says nothing about a subject test.

notes: Public Health Sciences runs its own admissions on SOPHAS. Epidemiology and Prevention Science PhDs (also Public Health) have no matching field id. The Biostatistics PhD deadline page shows only past (Fall 2026) dates.
